password.title: Change password
password.expiredHint: Your password has expired. Enter your current password, a new password, and the captcha.
password.required: Complete all fields and enter a valid captcha.
password.mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
password.reused: The new password must differ from the current password.

personal.title: Personal settings
personal.description: Language and theme are saved in this browser.

organization.name: Name
organization.invalidCode: Use 1–30 letters, digits, hyphens or underscores

user.title: Users
user.invalidUsername: Use 3–100 letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens
user.passwordHint: At least 12 characters with upper- and lowercase letters, a digit and a symbol (per the system password policy).
user.passwordRejected: The password does not meet the password policy, or the username is invalid.
user.notAssigned: Not yet granted for this company; saving adds it
user.companyAccessActive: Access to this company is active
user.organizationUnavailable: Branches or departments of this company could not be loaded (you may lack view permission). You can leave them empty.

role.title: Roles
role.name: Role name
role.dataScopeHint: Controls which records this role can see. When several roles grant the same permission, the widest scope applies.
role.fullAccessHint: A full-access role automatically has every permission, including ones added later; no need to tick them.
role.invalidCode: Use 1–50 letters, digits, hyphens or underscores
role.deleteConfirm: Delete role {{code}}? The code cannot be reused afterwards.

numberRule.title: Document number rules
numberRule.name: Name
numberRule.lockedHint: Numbers have been issued with this rule. The date format and reset period are locked and the sequence length cannot be shortened.
numberRule.invalidDocumentType: Use {PREFIX}.{DOCUMENT}, e.g. SD.ORDER (letters, digits or underscore; at most 50 characters)
numberRule.invalidPrefix: Use at most 10 letters, digits, hyphens or underscores
numberRule.invalidLength: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}
numberRule.periodNotCovered: The date format must contain the reset period (yearly needs the year, monthly the month, daily the day); otherwise numbers would repeat.
numberRule.previewHint: Previewing does not use up a number. The actual number is assigned when the document is saved.

approvalFlow.title: Approval flows
approvalFlow.name: Name
approvalFlow.selfApprovalHint: When off, the submitter cannot approve their own document even if they are an approver.
approvalFlow.editHint: Changes apply to new submissions only; pending approvals keep the steps they were submitted with. Inactive flows approve submissions automatically.
approvalFlow.thresholdHint: Steps run in order. A step with a minimum amount applies only when the document amount (base currency) is at least that amount; a step without one always applies.
approvalFlow.invalidStepName: Enter a step name of 1–100 characters.
approvalFlow.invalidAmount: Enter a non-negative amount with up to 11 digits and 4 decimal places.
approvalFlow.invalidDocumentType: Use {PREFIX}.{DOCUMENT}, for example PUR.ORDER (letters, digits or underscores, up to 50 characters)
approvalFlow.optionsUnavailable: Roles or users could not be loaded (viewing roles and users needs permission). Approvers are shown by ID.

approvalDelegation.title: Approval delegates
approvalDelegation.usersUnavailable: Users could not be loaded (viewing users needs permission).
approvalDelegation.usersRequired: Select both the delegator and the delegate.
approvalDelegation.sameUser: The delegator and the delegate must be different users.
approvalDelegation.datesRequired: Enter the start and end dates.
approvalDelegation.invalidRange: The end date cannot be earlier than the start date.
approvalDelegation.hint: During the period (both dates included) the delegate can approve the delegator's steps. Delegation does not chain, and active periods of the same delegator cannot overlap.

approval.title: Approvals
approval.noTasks: No approvals are waiting for you
approval.commentRequired: A comment is required when rejecting.
approval.forwarded: {{no}} was approved and sent to the next step.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.invalidRange: The end date cannot be earlier than the start date.

ipWhitelist.title: IP whitelist
ipWhitelist.rangeHint: Enter a complete IPv4/IPv6 address or CIDR network address.
ipWhitelist.invalid: Check the IP address, target, and dates.
ipWhitelist.disableHint: This rule will no longer allow connections.

parameters.title: System parameters
parameters.readOnly: You can view parameters only. Saving requires edit permission.

printSettings.title: Print settings
printSettings.previewHint: If the company name is blank, the company's registered name is printed.

companyImages.title: Logo & stamp
companyImages.hint: PNG or JPEG, up to 1 MB, 16–2048 pixels wide and high. Whether they are printed is set in Print settings.
companyImages.readOnly: You can view the images only. Uploading requires parameter edit permission.
